subject: Renewal + Capacity Add: PO routing, proration invoice, and billing owner transfer
messages:
From: Amir Khan <procurement@stellarsys.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: finance@stellarsys.com; legal@stellarsys.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing details

Hi Rafael,

We ready to move forward on the renewal for Q3 usage plus the additional 200k token capacity that we discussed. Finance wants the PO in place before term change and asks for a prorated invoice for the remainder of the current term. A couple of items we need confirmed:

- Can Redwood accept a single PO (StellarSys_PO_6789.pdf) that covers the renewal + upsell and the prorated charge?
- Our legal asked for clear invoice dates and a statement about how the prorate was calculated (pro-rata by days remaining).
- We are switching billing contact from kate.harrison@stellarsys.com to finance@stellarsys.com effective at renewal. Can you route invoices to finance@stellarsys.com starting Apr 15?
- We will attach a W9 for payment processing — will that be sufficient for US tax on your side?

We'd like to get this wrapped this week. Please confirm next steps and any docs you need.

Thanks,
Amir
Senior Buyer, Procurement
StellarSys

Attachment: StellarSys_PO_6789.pdf
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Amir Khan <procurement@stellarsys.com>
Cc: finance@stellarsys.com; monica.patel@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing details

Hi Amir — thanks for the PO and clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

- Yes, we can accept the single PO (StellarSys_PO_6789.pdf) for the renewal and the additional 200k tokens. Please include the HubSpot deal id (DEAL-7842) in the PO reference field to ensure it routes to the right account.
- We'll issue a prorated invoice that breaks out the renewal fixed charge, the upsell portion, and the days-prorated amount for the remainder of the current term. I'll attach a provisional prorated invoice for your review (Redwood_Invoice_20280403-prorated.pdf).
- Billing contact update: we can route future invoices to finance@stellarsys.com effective the renewal date (Apr 15). Please confirm whether you still need copies to kate.harrison@stellarsys.com for 30 days after the switch.
- W9 is sufficient for U.S. payments; thank you for attaching it. Our accounting team will need the PDF W9 and the PO tied together for payment.

Next steps I propose:
1) Amir — confirm whether kate should remain CC'd for 30 days.
2) Amir/Finance — review the provisional prorated invoice and confirm the math.
3) Once confirmed, we'll send a DocuSign amendment for the term change (Net30 -> Net45) if that's still requested by legal. If legal prefers unchanged payment terms, note that in the reply.

Cc'ing Monica (accounts) and Marissa (renewal ops) to handle invoicing and DocuSign.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_20280403-prorated.pdf
From: Lindsay Park <finance@stellarsys.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com; Amir Khan <procurement@stellarsys.com>
Cc: legal@stellarsys.com; kate.harrison@stellarsys.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO and billing details

Thanks Rafael — quick notes from finance after reviewing the provisional invoice:

- The prorate calculation looks correct, but please include a one-line description on the invoice showing the "prorated period" (e.g., Apr 15–Jun 14, 2028) and how many days were used to compute the prorate.
- We will keep kate.harrison@stellarsys.com copied for 30 days, but primary invoices should go to finance@stellarsys.com starting Apr 15.
- Regarding payment terms: we typically operate on Net45 for renewals > $50k. Legal asked us to request Net45 on the renewal amendment. If Redwood requires Net30, please flag and we can route to Treasury for approval.

We attached the signed PO (StellarSys_PO_6789.pdf) on our side. Please send the final invoice and the DocuSign amendment to finance@stellarsys.com.

Lindsay Park
Director of Finance, StellarSys

Attachment: StellarSys_W9.pdf

Quick update from billing ops: we've prepared the final prorated invoice and the renewal amendment reflecting the capacity add. Summary:

- Invoice Redwood_Invoice_20280403-prorated.pdf (final): includes line items for base renewal, 200k token upsell, and prorated credit for Apr 15–Jun 14, 2028 (61 days used in calculation). Line-level dates and calculation are included.
- DocuSign amendment: term updated to reflect Net45 payment terms per your request; please review and e-sign. Link below.
- We will route future invoices to finance@stellarsys.com beginning with the May invoice. Kate will remain copied through May 15 for handoff.

Action items for StellarSys:
1) Sign the DocuSign amendment (if legal is okay with Net45).
2) Confirm PO reference on signed DocuSign (DEAL-7842 / PO 6789).
3) Confirm bank wiring instructions will go to the remit address on the invoice.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.com/Redwood/Envelope/1234
Invoice attached and also posted to the shared Drive folder.
